blurb: Hélicraft offers helicopter tours over Montreal, Magog, and Montérégie, as well as pilot initiation experiences. Tours provide aerial views of landmarks and natural sites. Pilot experiences include briefing, flying with an instructor, and debriefing.
extraNote: Tours available 7 days a week until sunset · Tours from Magog available June 1 to August 31 daily, then weekends until October 31
